conditions: Source is a secondary copy of the LPA Master Plan 2031 zoning regulations; confirm the official current text and amendments.
The FAR lookup assumes the selected regulatory land-use category is confirmed from the applicable notified land-use map.
Road width must be the legally recognised width of the abutting public road, not a map estimate.
For apartment/group housing sites of 1 hectare or more, the group-housing pathway may apply; SiteIQ switches to the configured group-housing table for a residential-apartment use.
Site area is 1 hectare or more, so the Master Plan copy treats an apartment building of this size as group housing.

Source requires 15% combined reservation for park/open space and civic amenity, with at least 10% for parks/open space and 5% for civic amenity. FAR basis is net of the 5% civic-amenity reservation; the park area is not additionally deducted in this calculation based on the transcribed wording.
A development plan for building blocks, access roads, parks/open spaces and civic amenity areas is required before building-plan approval under the source text.
The authority's site hosts two copies. The signed final adds a row of FAR 1.5 at 9 m and a 9 m approach road; the other requires 12 m. SiteIQ keeps 12 m until the authority confirms.
far.far_interpretation: Group-housing FAR table selected for apartment/group-housing use on sites of at least 1 hectare; floor-area capacity is calculated on net site area after the civic-amenity deduction.

premium_far.message: Optional additional FAR up to 0.6× base FAR may be available through a Premium FAR/TDR combination under the cited scheme. This is not included in the base benchmark and is not an entitlement; charges, mix and eligibility are not calculated.
conditions: The 2026 Premium FAR amendment discussed in the Karnataka High Court judgment permits additional FAR up to 0.6 times ordinary FAR under conditions; this is not automatic and requires premium charge/TDR compliance.

For roads >=9 m but <12 m, the judgment says additional FAR is available only through TDR, not Premium FAR charges. For roads >=12 m, the 0.6× additional FAR ceiling requires a combination of Premium FAR and TDR; exact Table 27 charge/premium mix is not configured.

The judgment identifies amendments for Hoskote, Kanakapura, Anekal, Channapatna, Magadi, Nelamangala, BIAAPA and Ramanagara LPAs. Verify the relevant notification and site eligibility for this exact authority.

limits: This is an early-stage feasibility aid, not sanction advice or a legal opinion.

Bengaluru RMP 2015 has a partial configured profile. Hoskote, Kanakapura, Nelamangala and Anekal use provisional FAR candidates compared with the Master Plan 2031 text each authority publishes; later amendments, zoning and authority coverage require confirmation. Other authority profiles remain unconfigured.

A rule-based FAR is a candidate from the configured source, not a sanctioned entitlement. Confirm the exact authority, official land-use classification, notification validity and applicable conditions.

SiteIQ can use a validated imported boundary area and calculate preliminary envelopes. Complex concave geometry, frontage-specific interpretations and all statutory overlays still need architect/authority review.
Gross area is footprint times above-ground floor count; FAR exclusions, ancillary areas, floor-by-floor variations, parking, structure and service constraints are not fully modelled.
